trial_court: Court of Shri Sanjeev Kumar Singh: Administrative Civil Judge (Central) : Delhi
case_name: Smt. Sona Devi @ Son Wati vs The State

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sona Devi @ Son Wati, wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks succession certificate for debts and securities of deceased Prem Singh. Objector Kamlesh Kumari claims to be legally wedded wife, while petitioner is the only one claiming maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person claiming to be the legally wedded wife to prove her claim.
legal_principles.held: He has stated that petitioner Smt. Sona Devi @ Sonwati is the legally wedded wife of the deceased Sh. Prem Singh and deceased Prem Singh never taken divorce from the petitioner as per his knowledge.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise maintenance order passed by a court is binding on the parties.
legal_principles.held: He has stated that petitioner filed a maintenance petition against Prem Singh in the year 1975 and thereafter the said matter was compromised and the Hon'ble Court passed a maintenance order on 21.10.1976

outcome.final_order: Succession certificate granted in favour of the petitioner.

use_for_drafting: guidelines for filing a succession certificate
